title: 장례식장 조문: 뭘 하면 되고, 뭘 하면 안 돼요?
objective: Use -(으)면 되다 / -(으)면 안 되다 for funeral manners and say a short condolence phrase.
summary: Learn what to do and say at a Korean funeral hall.
setting: A hospital funeral hall in the evening. Mark, a foreign employee, visits with his coworker Jieun to pay respects. Their team leader's father has passed away.

task.title: Use funeral hall expressions
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, put in order, or answer in Korean using the words and patterns from page 1.

words.meaning: chief mourner (the family member who receives guests)
words.exampleMeaning: I greeted the chief mourner and came out.

words.meaning: condolence money given to the family
words.exampleMeaning: You put condolence money in a white envelope.
I wrote my company name in the guest book too.

words.meaning: portrait of the deceased shown at the funeral
words.exampleMeaning: Grandpa was smiling in the funeral portrait.

words.meaning: peace in the afterlife (used in condolence phrases)
words.exampleMeaning: May the deceased rest in peace. (common in texts and on cards)

words.meaning: grief, a broken heart ("상심이 크시겠어요" is a spoken phrase you can say face to face to the chief mourner, unlike the written phrase with 명복)
words.exampleMeaning: You must be heartbroken by the sudden news.

dialogue.korean: 지은 씨, 장례식장은 처음이라서 좀 긴장돼요. 들어가서 뭘 하면 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Jieun, it's my first time at a funeral hall, so I'm a bit nervous. What should I do when we go in?

dialogue.korean: 먼저 방명록에 이름을 쓰고 조의금을 내면 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: First, you just write your name in the guest book and hand in your condolence money.
What do I say to our team leader?

dialogue.korean: 말을 길게 하면 안 돼요. "상심이 크시겠어요." 정도로 짧게 하세요.
dialogue.meaning: You shouldn't talk for long. Keep it short, like "You must be heartbroken."
Team leader, you must be so heartbroken.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① ( 방명록 / 영정 ) 앞에서 묵념했어요. ② ( 조의금 / 상주 ) 봉투에 제 이름을 썼어요.
Fill in the blank with the pattern given in parentheses: ① 장례식장에서는 조용히 해야 해요. 큰 소리로 ____ (웃다, -(으)면 안 돼요) ② 먼저 방명록에 이름을 쓰고 조의금을 ____ (내다, -(으)면 돼요)
What would you say? Use a phrase from this worksheet: ① 장례식장에서 상주에게 직접 말로 인사할 때 (말로 하는 표현) ② 장례식장에 못 가서 문자로 위로할 때 (카드나 문자에 쓰는 표현)
Put the steps in order: (가) 상주에게 짧게 인사해요 (나) 방명록에 이름을 써요 (다) 조의금을 내요
Answer in Korean with -(으)면 안 돼요 and -(으)면 돼요 (Hint: 장례식장에서는 검은색이나 어두운 색 옷을 입어요.): 친구가 물어요. "장례식장에 빨간 티셔츠를 입고 가도 돼요?"
answers: ① 웃으면 안 돼요 ② 내면 돼요
① 상심이 크시겠어요. ② 삼가 고인의 명복을 빕니다.
아니요, 빨간 티셔츠를 입으면 안 돼요. 어두운 색 옷을 입으면 돼요. (검은색 옷을 입으면 돼요.)
